tone.voice: a brilliant teacher who believes in you — supportive, never condescending

ux_norms: progress tracking is always visible — completion percentage on every course, module, and assignment
streaks and achievements drive engagement — streak count and milestone badges always on home screen
video player is a primary UI component — custom controls, playback speed, quality selector always accessible
resume where you left off — always — last position in video, last completed lesson highlighted
course outline always accessible — slide-in panel or persistent sidebar depending on platform
lms course builder screens: instructor home leads with pending grades and active course stats — never student-facing content
lms course builder screens: course builder uses drag-to-reorder modules — handle always visible on module row left edge
lms course builder screens: lesson editor uses block-based content — add, remove, reorder blocks — never a single textarea
lms course builder screens: gradebook is a data table — student rows, assignment columns — always exportable
lms course builder screens: grading screen shows submission and grade input side by side — never navigate away to grade
lms course builder screens: student detail shows progress by module, not just overall percentage — granular view always
lms course builder screens: announcements composer always shows recipient count before sending — never send blind
lms course builder screens: discussion threads show unanswered questions with red dot — instructor response urgency always visible
offline access indicators for downloaded content — always visible — critical for mobile learners

photography_rules: real instructor photos for course cards — professional but approachable
diverse student representation in all human imagery
never use stuffy or traditional academic photography
visual_language.background_treatment: clean white or very light — let colour accents carry the energy
visual_language.empty_state_style: friendly illustrated character or object — encouraging copy (you've got this!)
visual_language.onboarding_visual: friendly flat vector illustration — learning journey theme
visual_language.illustration_style: flat vector, rounded shapes, diverse characters — warm and motivating

compliance_notes: COPPA compliance for apps targeting under-13
FERPA for student data in US

avoid: Never use gamification that trivialises learning — streaks and points must be secondary to content
Never show a student's grade to other students — isolation absolute
Never auto-advance through content without completion signal
Never use a countdown timer that creates anxiety during assessments without warning
Never truncate assignment instructions — full text always required
Never use aggressive upgrade prompts during active learning sessions
enforce: Progress always shown as lessons completed / total — never hidden
Deadline always shown in student's local timezone
Accessibility: all video content must have captions available
Content always saveable for offline access in paid tier
Academic integrity notice always visible on assessment screens
Student support contact always one tap away from any assessment screen
